label: November 30–December 6, 2026
intro: Christmas season kicks off: a gingerbread-building workshop, Santa at the Danish bazaar and Father's Day on Saturday!

activities.title: Kimpton Maa-Lai gingerbread house workshop — opening weekend
activities.why: Building AND decorating a gingerbread house he gets to take home — the perfect match for his building-and-making streak (and like his chocolate class).
activities.tip: Book ahead; go on Father's Day Saturday and make it a dad-and-Thor date.

activities.title: Danish Christmas Bazaar with Santa
activities.why: Santa Lucia parade, Santa Bill, a kids' room and Danish treats — very festive.
activities.tip: Pair it with the Kimpton workshop nearby the same day.

activities.title: Father's Day (King Bhumibol's birthday) — free rides & attractions
activities.price: Free entry at many sites (confirm for 2026)
activities.why: In past years dads rode BTS free with their kids and many museums waived fees — a great day for a museum hop together.
activities.tip: Check BTS and museum announcements a few days before.

activities.title: VEX Robotics Signature Event (spectating)
activities.why: Real robots built by students competing head-to-head — pure Iron Man-workshop energy.
activities.tip: Check public viewing times before you go.

activities.title: Onederous Christmas at One Bangkok — market & giant tree
activities.date: Daily from Tuesday December 1 (market to Dec 25)
activities.why: Eight big photo spots, a giant tree and festive music — easy after-school wander.
activities.tip: Weeknights are quieter; the Storeys Square market opens Dec 5.

activities.title: ICONSIAM Bangkok Illumination — giant golden Christmas tree
activities.why: Light shows on the river and a colour-changing Blessing Tree — magical for a 5-year-old.
activities.tip: Catch the 6:30pm show to be home for bedtime.

activities.title: Vijit Chao Phraya — weeknight river lights
activities.location: Riverfront sites along the Chao Phraya
activities.why: Lasers and projections on the river — more lights to chase.
